scenes.summary: Approaching the target location, two vigilant watchguards stand watch, posted at the intersection on Ye Minghe's orders. A crisis seems to be unfolding.

lines.text: You sure we shouldn't let Captain Mi ... I mean, Tianshi Zhuang know about this?
He told us to watch the intersection. Maybe some major disaster just blew up in there... It could be a Blight Tide ... or an Aggelos attack.
If Aggeloi are behind this, it would explain everything.
He's Imperial Guards "Captain of Pacified Skies"! Sure, that captain thing is a vanity title, but Tianshi Tan granted it to him herself!
Yeah. He must have squished so many Aggeloi to become a "pacifier of the skies"...
His parents were renowned soldiers, and he is a gifted fighter with great ambitions. He started his own military career very early.
It'll be fine, just relax a... Hey! Stop right there!
Endmin? I saw you back in Wuling City!
I received a message from Mister Minghe...
I see... Go ahead, please. He's over there.
See what I mean? Captain Minghe has covered every possibility...
But if he's called the Endmin here, it must be something serious...

scenes.summary: Ye Minghe proposes making burdenbeast bait from tartpepper. You realize that he is quite well-versed in burdenbeast handling and learn that this mysterious Imperial Guard has apparently raised them for a few years after the incident where you saved his life. Everything eventually goes back to you.

lines.text: Gallopers and burdenbeasts are quite different in temperament. I don't think they have any common language.
But, it'd be nice if Nuli is as mellow as a burdenbeast...
Yet ... the Endmin I knew ... would gladly do so.
You were never distant from people or from the mundane affairs of the world.
That's why I've always believed in your safe return, so we can usher in a treasured future filled with ordinary days...
A treasured future of ordinary days...
Are you studying ... the burdo-muck?
The HAS keeps tens of thousands of burdenbeasts, and they do more than just meet the needs of livelihood. It is a real science...
I can't find any more traces nearby. The burdenbeast probably went deeper into the meadows... Should we keep going?
Hmm...
Endmin, I know why this burdenbeast has gone astray.
This pat of burdo-muck is fresh, yet overly dry... The burdenbeast is looking for something — a remedy to soothe its gastric ailment.
Some plants nearby may achieve that effect. We can end the chase and just lure it over...
Are you alright?
I thought that Tianshi was joking... But you really are a burdo-master.
Well, I find them quite likable.
I'm an amateur hobbyist at best. A real farmer is leagues ahead of me.
A mellow Nuli won't carry you to battle.
Hah. Very true.
Ten years ago, you saved my life in battle. Since then, I spent years, and raised a good herd of burdenbeasts.
Wha?
It's not a short story. Once there's time, I'll give it to you in detail.
If that future does come, perhaps I can raise some burdenbeasts myself. A town, maybe. Or a village...
Actually, I know of such a place...
Let's get back to business, Endmin. We need tartpepper plants to prepare a bait.
The spicy aroma will lure the stray maverick back. If it has a gastric ailment, some tartpepper will do it well.
Got it.

options: Is this part of your hobby?
I guess you kept this secret for Nuli's sake?
Raising burdenbeasts? Did I ask you to do that?
Raising burdenbeasts? Did I raise some with you?

scenes.summary: The burdenbeast is baited but it suddenly runs away. You find traces of Si's ink nearby. The beast may have charged into Si's painting. You decide to follow.

lines.text: Just as I expected.
We should wait a while longer. Let it finish the tartpepper bait.
If that burdenbeast accidentally got some ink on itself, that would explain its irritation.
Plenty of things can make Lady Si curious. When she feels inspired, it's very likely she'll do some traveling and painting.
And she might have left a few works outside. Sui Regulator has recovered quite a few in recent years.
But Si lives somewhere else.
That sounds like her alright...
That doesn't look right...
I don't think I'm seeing things...
Perhaps there are other scrolls.
If Lady Si is involved, coincidentally or not, Hongshan must get it covered.
I just hope that burdenbeast didn't barge its way into Lady Si's work...
Agreed. We should keep up. After all, we did promise to bring it back.

options: Should we nab it right now?

lines.text: I believe our maverick busted its way in.
I don't know what Lady Si drew here. We'd be lucky if it's just a landscape painting. Please stay close. Things might be dangerous inside.
Endmin, if you're ready, we can proceed.

options: We best hurry. I say we follow.
I still have to take care of something...

scenes.summary: The commotion was a false alarm caused by spooked burdenbeasts, currently being calmed by Ye Minghe and a Tianshi. He wants to share memories of your past, but first, assist the Tianshi in finding the last missing burdenbeast.

lines.text: Hoo... We got it out.
Lucky for us we got two burdo-masters here. It'd be really bad if it swallowed the handyterm...
Give me five, Mister Minghe!
Endministrator? What brings you here?
Oops. I guess the maverick used your handyterm to tongue-toast a few of your friends...
My apologies. I didn't expect this. Sorry for taking up your time.
I'm just glad you're alright. I saw watchguards back there and got a little worried.
I came across an old friend by chance. We shared a few words but his herd suddenly became agitated...
So I asked the two watchguard officers to keep passers-by away to avoid injuries... Maybe they interpreted the situation wrongly.
*Sigh* Mister Minghe and Endmin, I'm really sorry for the trouble.
I'll take this maverick back to the pens. I would teach it a "real lesson".
I guess I should intercede for the poor creature.
I was trying to arrange a formal meeting with the Endmin to catch up a little... This beast actually helped with that.
Endmin, let me find a good place. I may need a bit more of your time.
Oh dear! One's still missing!
That's odd. Everyone's here in my last count...
Mister Minghe, I won't take up your or the Endmin's time. I gotta find my missing burdenbeast.
I guess you don't take your herd here often. New ground means new risks. We should go find it quickly.
Endmin...
Please do your things first. Once I'm finished here, I'll meet you at Dijiang and apologize properly.
That won't be necessary. I've already given you some of my time. I can give you a bit more.
The more hands the better. If we find it quickly, we may have time left for reminiscing.
I shouldn't trouble you with these chores.
Back in Si's painting, you helped me out as well.
And I dealt with quite a few burdenbeasts in Wuling. I can definitely help.
Thanks a lot for helping. Let's split our ways to make it quick.
